captions.detailed: This 3D model is a flat, thin spacer plate designed for a bicycle cleat. It has a rectangular footprint with rectangular notches cut out of all four corners, giving it a stepped profile. Two triangular cutouts are positioned symmetrically near the center to accommodate mounting hardware.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric bike cleat spacer in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to adjust the thickness of the spacer, the overall length and width, and the dimensions of the corner cutouts to fit different shoes.
captions.factory: The design starts with a main base plate created using a centered cube. A difference operation is performed on this base plate to subtract two cylinders for the mounting holes and four custom corner blocks. The corner blocks are defined in a separate helper module as cubes and are translated to each of the four corners of the main plate to create the notched profile.
